info.name: IDB Invest - Offboarding Data Exposure API
info.description: Postman collection for functional, contract, health, pagination, filtering and security validation of the governed read-only IDB Invest Offboarding Data Exposure API. Import together with postman/local.postman_environment.json. Local Function base URL defaults to http://localhost:7071/api. In hosted environments set baseUrl to the APIM/API URL and provide accessToken when authentication is enforced.

request.description: IDB standard deployable-app health endpoint. With baseUrl ending in /api, this calls GET /api/health. No bearer token is required.

exec: pm.test('Corporate health payload is coherent', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['Healthy','Unhealthy']).to.include(b.status); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql('Offboarding.Databricks.Facade'); pm.expect(['Healthy','Unhealthy']).to.include(b.databricks); if (b.status === 'Healthy') pm.response.to.have.status(200); else pm.response.to.have.status(503); });

pm.test('Dependency health payload is coherent', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['ok','degraded']).to.include(b.status); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql('Offboarding.Databricks.Facade'); pm.expect(['ok','unavailable']).to.include(b.databricks); if (b.databricks === 'ok') pm.response.to.have.status(200); else pm.response.to.have.status(503); });

pm.test('Dependency health payload is coherent', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['ok','degraded']).to.include(b.status); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql('Offboarding.Databricks.Facade'); pm.expect(['ok','unavailable']).to.include(b.databricks); if (b.databricks === 'ok') pm.response.to.have.status(200); else pm.response.to.have.status(503); });

pm.test('Liveness does not depend on Databricks', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql('Offboarding.Databricks.Facade'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('databricks'); });

pm.test('Dependency health payload is coherent', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['ok','degraded']).to.include(b.status); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql('Offboarding.Databricks.Facade'); pm.expect(['ok','unavailable']).to.include(b.databricks); if (b.databricks === 'ok') pm.response.to.have.status(200); else pm.response.to.have.status(503); });
pm.test('Metadata identifies the employees resource', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.resource).to.eql('employees'); });

pm.test('Metadata exposes fields and maximum page size', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.fields).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.maxPageSize).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Metadata does not expose physical Databricks source', function () { const raw = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('gold.offboarding.vw_employees'); });

pm.test('Metadata exposes logical model and contract version', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.model).to.eql('employee-offboarding-candidate'); pm.expect(body.contractVersion).to.eql('1.0'); });

pm.test('Error contract contains code and correlationId', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('correlationId'); });

item.name: Query employees with filters and paging

exec: pm.test('Response follows query envelope contract', function () { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.meta).to.be.an('object'); });

pm.test('Paging metadata matches request', function () { const m=pm.response.json().meta; pm.expect(m.page).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get('page') || pm.environment.get('page') || 1)); pm.expect(m.pageSize).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get('pageSize') || pm.environment.get('pageSize') || 100)); pm.expect(m).to.have.property('returned'); pm.expect(m).to.have.property('hasMore'); });

pm.test('Logical model and contract version are exposed', function () { const m=pm.response.json().meta; pm.expect(m.model).to.eql('employee-offboarding-candidate'); pm.expect(m.contractVersion).to.eql('1.0'); });
pm.test('Physical Databricks identifiers are not exposed', function () { const raw=pm.response.text(); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('vw_employees'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('employee_id'); });

pm.test('Invalid query uses normalized error contract', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql('INVALID_QUERY'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('message'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('correlationId'); });

item.name: Page size above resource limit is rejected
Malformed filter does not echo submitted value

exec: pm.test('Error does not echo submitted PII', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('private.person@iadb.org'); });
pm.test('Default paging is page 1 / pageSize 100', function () { const m=pm.response.json().meta; pm.expect(m.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(m.pageSize).to.eql(100); });
pm.test('Response is a query envelope', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.meta).to.be.an('object'); });

item.name: Swagger / OpenAPI
item.description: Runtime Swagger UI and OpenAPI contract endpoints. These requests are updated whenever API documentation routes change.

request.description: Same-origin JavaScript initializer used by Swagger UI.
Canonical OpenAPI 3.0 contract served by the Function App.

exec: pm.test('OpenAPI document has contract marker', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('openapi: 3.0.3'); });
